rows.context_and_review_note: Repeated ad before the coordinated restore verb for explicit parallel could not save OR restore syntax. Retained the catalogue recovery verb ssukn rather than substituting an uncertain synonym. Credits are described as information about source, creator and rights, not money and not a promise that all structured fields exist. qqimn is plural agreeing with isfka; the previously-saved relative modifier keeps the preservation statement limited to existing stored information, not the newest unsaved field. GalleryCredits.kt catches IOException both during editor construction/restoration (:77–79) and save callback; entries are updated only after callback success. ClassicPaintActivity.kt:1468 onward validates prospective edits, persists the session, then edits document credits; failed editor construction leaves the prior session association intact. CreditEditSession.kt:31–40 records prior accepted snapshot identities and writes the next revision before publishing in-memory acceptance; CreditSessionJson.kt:151–166 uses AtomicFile with failWrite rollback. These inspected paths support retention of prior saved credits, without promising the latest edit saved or restoration succeeded. This was a static scoped review, not a proof of every caller/concurrency interleaving. The separate legacy_credits_unreadable message is excluded from this batch.
